issues.reason: Coordination & plurals gives a plural referred to as a unit a group witness with (GroupOf <group> <kind>), and Compound concepts states that on a plural a descriptive modifier 'distributes over the members exactly like a copular predicate'; the parse instead used the singular 'a flock of birds' encoding for the plural 'large herds', so the plurality of herds is lost and 'large' is predicated of one herd.

gaps_confirmed: nested plurality — a plural of collective groups ('herds of cows'), where each member of the outer group is itself a GroupOf, has no specified encoding
a capitalized ethnonym used as a common-noun kind ('these Tuareg') — whether the proper-noun Name rule reaches a proper-noun-derived kind symbol is unaddressed
new_gaps: the inner 'of cows' still has no stated encoding once the outer plural is a group: it is carried in the per-member distribution rule's conclusion, which is true and well-typed but improvised
repair_summary: Replaced the single herd witness with the outer group sk_herds_1 typed (GroupOf sk_herds_1 herd); moved 'large' and the inner 'of cows' onto a per-member distribution rule over (PartOf $x sk_herds_1); re-pointed the event's Theme at the group.
notes: The Tuareg group witness, Holder/Theme on 'have' and the Past atom are untouched. No per-member rule was added for the possession itself — the collective reading of 'these Tuareg had herds' is defensible and no confirmed issue names it.
